KR.title: Story time 😂 So what had happened was… lol they came and checked me, I was 5.5cm dilated. 3 hours later they checked again and I was still there more or less I was told. 40 minutes later & I am going through ittt but since I had just been checked, I didn’t want the nurse to check again only to get discouraged. Welp, Celine had her own plans and no one was ready 😅 The nicu team was on their way bc she had pooped inside of me so they needed to do an immediate check. Their faces say it all as they walk in. Thank God for hubby being the calm, cool & collect soul that he is bc idk how he handled it so well lol the nurse thought he was in the medical field 🤣  Our Celine made quite the entrance into this world & I love that I have a story to tell her when she’s older 🥰 also, shoutout to our MVP of a nurse Emily who made my labor experience so amazing! 💕 Also, I need to know.. has this happened to anyone else? lol © 2026 All rights reserved. Welp, Celine had her own plans and no one was ready 😅 The nicu team was on their way bc she had pooped inside of me so they needed to do an immediate check. Their faces say it all as they walk in. Thank God for hubby being the calm, cool & collect soul that he is bc idk how he handled it so well lol the nurse thought he was in the medical field 🤣  Our Celine made quite the entrance into this world & I love that I have a story to tell her when she’s older 🥰 also, shoutout to our MVP of a nurse Emily who made my labor experience so amazing! 💕 Also, I need to know.. has this happened to anyone else? lol © 2026 All rights reserved.
